title: NDT Factory: Synthesizing Verified Network Digital Twins from Semantic Models via Multi-Agent LLM
abstract: arXiv:2609.12170v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous network management requires systems that can evaluate Network Service Intents (NSIs) under varying conditions without manual implementation of analysis logic, as envisioned in TM Forum Level~4 (L4) autonomy. Behavioral Network Digital Twins (NDTs) enable such evaluation, but existing NDTs rely on pre-defined analytical logic, limiting adaptability for evolving closed-loop control. This paper introduces the NDT factory, a multi-agent software system that synthesizes executable behavioral NDTs on demand from semantic models using Large Language Model (LLM). We validate the system using a Call Admission Control (CAC) case study, where deterministic what-if analysis serves as the admission decision process. The NDT factory generates a complete CAC NDT through parallel synthesis and orchestration, achieving 100% compilation and test pass rates across multiple runs. translated_title: NDT工厂：通过多智能体大语言模型从语义模型合成经验证的网络数字孪生
translated_abstract: 自主网络管理需要能够在不同条件下评估网络服务意图（NSI）而无需手动实现分析逻辑的系统，正如TM Forum L4级自治所设想的那样。行为网络数字孪生（NDT）能够实现此类评估，但现有的NDT依赖于预定义的分析逻辑，限制了其对不断演进的闭环控制的适应性。本文介绍了NDT工厂，这是一个多智能体软件系统，利用大语言模型（LLM）按需从语义模型合成可执行的行为网络数字孪生。我们通过呼叫准入控制（CAC）案例研究对该系统进行了验证，其中确定性的假设分析作为准入决策过程。NDT工厂通过并行合成与编排生成完整的CAC NDT，在多次运行中实现了100%的编译和测试通过率。对300个NSI的仿真显示，其决策一致性达到99.3%。
tldr: 本文提出NDT工厂，一个基于多智能体大语言模型的软件系统，可按需从语义模型自动合成经验证的可执行行为网络数字孪生，在呼叫准入控制案例中实现了100%的编译与测试通过率及99.3%的决策一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the NDT Factory, a multi-agent LLM-based software system that synthesizes verified executable behavioral Network Digital Twins on demand from semantic models, achieving 100% compilation and test pass rates and 99.3% decision agreement in a Call Admission Control case study.
